approval: Parent must perform normal formal execution approval. Source preparation is not execution authorization. No request to change security settings or ownership checks.

fixed_data_reads.purpose: vptr340A00 + 0x10 compressor slot; output pointer and verify executable on-disk target section only
10A884 ADDSS source constant; output exact bits and float32 disk value

output.failure_policy: Keep created directory and failure report; never remove evidence or retry within the reader. Refusal before a safe output directory exists is surfaced as an exception.

guards: Fixed Windows workspace and script name; no command-line path parameters.
Source and proof files must be regular, single-link files with nonzero inode; ancestor lstat and native realpath checks.
Parent must ensure the required Windows Attributes/reparse checks on source and path chain; Node cannot expose every reparse tag.
Proof hashes and Ghidra subject, digest, original path, operation, procedure and exact relevant assembly lines must match before original source is opened.
Original preopen stat, opened descriptor stat, descriptor final stat and final source path stat must agree; same descriptor is hashed before and after.
Section mapping must be unique and file backed; slot/constant sections readable and nonexecutable; pointer target executable with file backing.
No target function body, adjacent slot, RTTI, other original file, save data, subprocess or backend.
interpretation: An executable address is a precise disk-slot binding, not verified decoder semantics, live object identity or native runtime compatibility. Constant observation is also on-disk only.
